messages:
oncall-bot: Pager alert — P0: gen-queue-backlog in us-west (high error-rate + tail latency). Incident ID: INC-2026-4371. Link: https://ops/alerts/INC-2026-4371

alex chen: I'm oncall, picking this up. Starting runbook checks and logs now.

kia: Thx alex. Any initial customer impact?

alex chen: Repro'd. gen-worker pool OOM triggered autoscale thrash; requests started queuing ~20-40s and some 5xx from the generation layer. No DB errors observed.

maria: Preparing statuspage copy. Draft below — please edit:  
```
Initial update (investigating): We are investigating elevated error rates and increased latency for generation endpoints in US-West. Some requests may return errors or see delays of 20–60 seconds. Our on-call team is actively mitigatin g and will post updates every 15 minutes. No evidence of data leakage at this time.
```

sara: Quick note: avoid absolute phrasing on data. Legal want "no evidence" rather than "no data leakage"? @legal-team can confirm.

legal-team: Confirm — use "no evidence of data compromise" and avoid promises.

maria: Updated copy with legal change:  
```
Initial update (investigating): We are investigating elevated error rates and increased latency for generation endpoints in US-West. Some requests may return errors or see delays of 20–60 seconds. Our on-call team is actively mitigating and will post updates every 15 minutes. There is currently no evidence of customer data compromise.
```

alex chen: Running mitigation: temporarily increase gen-worker ReplicaCount + deploy config that routes small batched requests to fallback-model-smol. Rolling in 2 patches, will watch queue depth.

kia: ETA? I can coordinate publishing once we have a measurable improvement.

alex chen: Patch 1 applied (scale + queue cap). Patch 2 (routing) in progress, starting now. Logs: 
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/gen-worker -n prod-usw
// scaled replicas 4 -> 8
```

oncall-bot: Alert update — queue depth decreasing. Error-rate down from 12% -> 4% in last 5m.

alex chen: Routing patch live. Queue drain observed, tail latency 95p down from 45s -> ~8s. No new 5xx in last 2m.

sara: Good — draft a 15-min status update that notes mitigation and next steps. Suggesting:  
```
15-minute update: We implemented scaling and a temporary routing change which has reduced failures and significantly improved latency. We are continuing to monitor and will keep work to fully stabilize the gen-worker autoscaler and investigate root cause. Customers may still see occasional elevated latencies while traffic normalizes.
```

maria: Added that, and included expected next update time (+15m).

legal-team: Approve updated customer wording.

alex chen: Monitoring. Queue stable, no regression in error-rate for 10m. Marking incident as "mitigated" in runbook.

oncall-bot: Incident status -> mitigated.

sara: Can you draft resolved copy when you're comfortable? We should wait until 30m of stable metrics to publish resolved.

alex chen: Agreed. If stable for 30m I'll post resolved. Current metrics: 30m window: error-rate 0.8%, 95p latency 2.1s.

maria: Draft resolved notice:  
```
Resolved: The elevated error rates and high latency impacting generation endpoints in US-West have been resolved. We applied temporary scaling and routing changes to reduce queueing and errors. We are continuing a post-incident investigation to identify the root cause and will follow up with a summary. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support.
```

legal-team: Slight wording tweak: change "applied temporary scaling" -> "applied temporary capacity and routing changes".

maria: Updated resolved copy.

alex chen: Confirming 40m stable. Publishing resolved now.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-4371 - Resolved. Notifying subscribers and updating statuspage.

sara: Thanks team. Assign follow-up action: post-mortem and autoscaler tuning. Whoever owns autoscaler (platform infra) — we'll add an action item.

maria: I'll file the statuspage history entry and attach the three updates (initial, 15-min, resolved) to the incident ticket.

alex chen: Leaving notes in incident ticket with timings and links to logs.

kia: Nice work. :thumbsup:

alex chen: Thanks. Closing on-call thread.

oncall-bot: This thread will be archived. For any reopens, tag incident-ops.
